title: Electrical Engineer II (Integrations)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing. 🚀 What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers. Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team. Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows. Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets. Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process. title: Data Scientist
description: **We are seeking skilled Data Scientist** to join our Data Science team within the Enterprise Intelligence Platforms, IT department. This role focuses on developing and implementing advanced AI and machine learning models to enhance our stainless steel and ferrochrome production processes. The successful candidate will work closely with various stakeholders to optimize production, improve product quality, and streamline raw material procurement. We work in close collaboration with development and R&D engineers at our stainless steel and ferrochrome production sites. Part of the job is to communicate data analysis and modelling results to stakeholders with various backgrounds. Also knowledge from manufacturing industries helps in this position. For example, familiarity with such concepts as statistical process control (SPC), six sigma or quality assurance in manufacturing industries is beneficial. We have also projects with other business units, for example with sales, so expertise e.g. in market forecasting, pricing optimization, document extraction and similar use cases is a benefit. **Key Responsibilities:** - Develop AI and machine learning models for production optimization, end product quality, energy use and raw material optimization. - Create time series and computer vision algorithms for stainless steel and ferrochrome production. - Productize ML/AI models by integrating them into other applications or standalone user interfaces. - Communicate effectively with stakeholders and participate in project planning, including planning of epics, features, and user stories. Responsibilities: - Maintain high code quality. - Participate in application, PI, and sprint planning. - Adhere to best architectural and cybersecurity standards. **Requirements:** - Masters or Bachelors degree in a relevant field. Doctoral degree is an advantage. - At least two years practical experience in data-science domain. - At least one of the following: expertise in AI/LLMs (incl. deep learning), machine learning, optimization, statistics or computer vision. - Knowledge of Python, R or similar programming languages is mandatory. - Enthusiasm using AI coding tools. Experience in extensive use of AI tools in modelling and software development is an advantage. - Working knowledge of basic developer tools (e.g. version control) and software development principles is required. - Experience in deploying and managing AI/ML models in production is an advantage. You dont need to master all tools and skills mentioned above, but working experience with programming languages is mandatory. **Stakeholders**: Collaborate with other EIP teams, R&D engineers, QA engineers, and development engineers from Steel Melting shop, Hot Rolling Mill, and Cold Rolling Mill departments in Tornio. **For more information,** please contact Head of Data Science, Mikko Havimo, mikko.havimo(at) outokumpu.com or TA partner Miikka Enbuske, miikka.enbuske(at) outokumpu.com If you are passionate about leveraging data science to drive innovation in stainless steel production, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. **Apply latest 30th of October 2026.** **The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment**

title: DevOps Engineer
description: We have a strong and growing product development organization made up of experienced professionals and talented junior engineers. Our product roadmap is healthy well into the future, offering a variety of technically meaningful challenges. To support our long-term roadmap and ambitious technology goals, we are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to help develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable efficient, secure, and high-quality software and product delivery. We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in DevOps toolchains, automation, CI/CD, and Kubernetes-based platforms. **Your** **role** As a **DevOps Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the development infrastructure used throughout the product lifecycle, including the underlying network connectivity and security controls. The environment includes source code and artifact management, build and release automation, test infrastructure, Kubernetes-based platforms, and integrations supporting requirements management, verification, validation, and product releases. You will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline development workflows and introduce modern tools and practices that support developers in their daily work. **Main Responsibilities** - Maintain and continuously improve the development environment and DevOps toolchain, manage source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact repositories. - Design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient network connectivity for development, build, test and deployment environments and troubleshoot issues. - Support network architecture and configuration for Kubernetes-based platforms, including ingress controls, load balancing, DNS, service connectivity, network policies and certificate management. - Ensure development infrastructure complies with relevant standards, cybersecurity requirements, and regulations. - Automate manual processes and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, reliability, traceability, and quality. - Integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and compliance checks into the software development lifecycle. - Evaluate, implement, and support AI-powered tools that enhance developer productivity. - Administer developer tools and software, integrate development data sources to provide clear visibility and reporting across the product development lifecycle. **Your profile** Our ideal candidate has a strong background in DevOps, automation, and software development tooling. You are a proactive, hands-on professional who can apply industry best practices to modern, highly secure and regulated engineering environments. **Required Skills** - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent. - Minimum five years of relevant experience in DevOps, Build Engineering, Software Tooling, or a similar role. - Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, TLS/PKI, and network segmentation. - Experience with DevOps technologies such as GitLab, Git, Docker, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar. - Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes. - Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes-based container platforms. - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure software development, open-source software governance, and DevSecOps practices. - Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions. - Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar). - Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken. We do not expect you to meet every requirement listed above. If you have a strong DevOps background, a hands-on mindset, and experience in many of the areas described, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges just as much as experience with specific tools. **What you will be part of** Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of Saab Surveillance business area. Our R&D teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people safe**. As an example of a brilliant product we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact! We support flexible ways of working and offer opportunities for occasional remote work when the nature of the tasks allows. As a DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to continuously improve our development platforms, tools, and processes. Because of this close collaboration and the nature of our development environment, most work is carried out on-site at our modern Saab Technology Center in Tampere. On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options. In this job, some of your tasks have a connection to defense secrecy. Therefore, a drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance act 726/2014 is required for the selected applicant. **Why join us?** - Play a key role in enabling the development of cutting-edge electronic warfare systems - Work with modern DevOps technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and automation solutions - Take ownership of processes and solutions that directly support product development and delivery - Collaborate with highly skilled software, systems, and engineering professionals - Grow your expertise through continuous learning, training opportunities, and challenging technical projects We are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides. **Interested?** Take your chance to build your future career at Saab by submitting your CV and application via Saab Careers already now!
